summary: Configured and verified the three-node OpenTelemetry routing gateway. HTTPS/mTLS, strict namespace rejection, exclusive routing, JSON retention, and client credentials are operational.
actions_performed: Installed OpenTelemetry Collector Contrib v0.159.0 on all nodes.
Generated separate server, ingress-client, and inter-collector TLS identities on managed nodes.
Configured node1 as the OTLP/HTTP HTTPS gateway on port 4318.
Configured append-mode payments retention on node2 and inventory retention on node3.
Behaviorally tested valid routing, rejection, mTLS enforcement, cross-routing, and duplicate delivery.

evidence.requirement: HTTPS OTLP/HTTP gateway and client credentials
evidence.summary: Node1 is active and listening on 10.100.33.10:4318; its configuration validates. The credentials under /root/otel-client work, while unauthenticated TLS fails.
Both backends reject connections without a client certificate and accept node1's gateway certificate. End-to-end routed delivery succeeded over these links.

evidence.requirement: Exclusive payments and inventory routing without duplicates
evidence.summary: A mixed request returned HTTP 200. Its payments span occurred exactly once on node2 and zero times on node3; its inventory span occurred exactly once on node3 and zero times on node2.
Missing and unsupported namespaces both returned HTTP 503. Neither rejected span appeared in either backend file, and record counts remained unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Retain accepted traces at the required paths
evidence.summary: Node2 uses append-mode JSON at /var/lib/otel/payments.json and contains only payments namespaces. Node3 uses append-mode JSON at /var/lib/otel/inventory.json and contains only inventory namespaces.
